solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Resistance insufficiently worn down?

definitions.meaning: a resistance movement operates in secret, out of sight of an occupying power
split in two: not ground down enough

explanation.surface: A grumble about a resistor or a fighter whose spirit has not been sufficiently crushed.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word into UNDER (not enough) and GROUND (worn down by grinding).
explanation.definitionFit: A clandestine resistance movement is called the underground, a secret organisation working against an occupier.

clue.text: Medic fills latter two-thirds of chests and leaves high-level station

indicators.note: the medic word fills, goes inside, the other piece
keep only the last two-thirds of the word, dropping its first third

parts.note: trunks are large storage chests
a doc is a doctor, a medic

explanation.surface: A doctor attends to chests, then leaves a space station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'latter two-thirds of' drops the first third of the six-letter word, leaving UNKS; 'fills' puts the medic inside that.
explanation.definitionFit: A spacecraft that undocks detaches and leaves an orbiting station, high above the Earth.

clue.text: Vicar's a kind of card — turning up as loon?

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means read from the bottom, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a vicar's title
an ID is an identity card

explanation.surface: A vicar shows up holding a card and is taken for a loon, a madman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loon' looks like a crazy person, but it is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Loon is the North American name for the bird the British call a diver.

clue.text: Arrest led convert into times of increased vigilance

indicators.note: to convert something is to change its form, so these letters are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: An arrest triggers periods of heightened security.
explanation.definitionFit: A red alert is the highest state of readiness, when everyone is on guard for danger.

clue.text: Make new version of altar-screen — about quarter lost from sides

indicators.note: lost from sides says letters are taken off both ends

parts.note: a reredos is an ornamental screen behind a church altar
re means about, concerning
S, south, is one of the compass quarters

explanation.surface: An instruction to remake a church altar-screen, trimmed at its edges.
explanation.walkthrough: RE comes off the front and S off the back of REREDOS.
explanation.definitionFit: To redo something is to do it again, producing a fresh version.

clue.text: A swimmer in Boulogne's sixth to go for detox

indicators.note: the sixth letter of the French phrase is dropped

parts.note: in Boulogne, France, a fish is un poisson

explanation.surface: A swimmer in the French port has his sixth place taken away, perhaps for a drugs test.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swimmer' is a fish, in French; the sixth letter of UNPOISSON is an S.
explanation.definitionFit: To detoxify is to remove toxins; to unpoison is to undo a poisoning.

clue.text: Victor's wearing composition jacket

indicators.note: wearing says the Victor letter has the other piece around it like clothing

parts.note: a duet is a musical composition for two
V is Victor in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A man named Victor is wearing a jacket he composed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jacket' looks like a coat; it is the cover of a quilt.
explanation.definitionFit: A duvet is a quilt, and its cover or the quilt itself serves as a jacket for the bed; a duvet jacket is also a padded coat.

clue.text: I daren't mess about, so get off at 12, maybe

indicators.note: to mess about with something is to jumble it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A traveller too nervous to fool around simply leaves the train at a station.
explanation.walkthrough: 12 is VICTORIA, a London rail terminus where you might leave a train.
explanation.definitionFit: To detrain is to alight from a train, as a passenger would at a mainline station.

clue.text: Food from Brazil, say, having nothing of French 'ton'

parts.note: a Brazil is a kind of nut
rien is French for nothing

explanation.surface: A Brazilian dish with none of that French chic or style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ton' looks like French for tone or fashion; here it is the weight, abbreviated T.
explanation.definitionFit: A nutrient is a substance that nourishes, so food in its broad sense.

clue.text: Cook did pud — I've done the sharing out

indicators.note: to cook figures or accounts is to fiddle them, so the letters that follow are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of making a pudding and then fairly portioning it out at the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cook' looks like a kitchen instruction for the pudding, but it signals an anagram of DID PUD I'VE.
explanation.definitionFit: Having divided something up means having done the job of sharing it out into portions.

clue.text: Clear cellar

definitions.meaning: to clear a fence or bar is to leap over it
an underground storeroom, especially for wine

explanation.surface: Two terse words that could be an order to empty out a basement.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: leaping over an obstacle, and an arched underground storage room.

clue.text: Regularly act in racy French version of the 'Ring'?

indicators.note: regularly says take every other letter of the words that follow

parts.note: le is the French masculine word for 'the'

explanation.surface: A racy French staging of Wagner's Ring cycle, with the performers acting in it.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of ACT IN RACY give CIRC. The question mark flags that this Ring is a shape, not Wagner's operas; the Circle is also a London Underground line.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring and a circle are synonyms, each a round closed shape or band.

clue.text: Plum pivotal part of debonair civilian reverting to an insider

indicators.note: an insider is something placed within, so the little word to goes inside the reversed letters
reverting means turning back, so the extracted letters are read backwards
the pivot of a phrase is its centre, so the central letters of the two words are taken

explanation.surface: Reads like a society column about a smooth civilian and a well-placed insider who is a real 'plum'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pivotal part of' takes the six central letters of the sixteen; 'reverting' turns them round to VICRIA, and 'an insider' sets TO within. Victoria is also a London Underground line.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victoria is a well-known English variety of plum, red and sweet, grown widely in gardens.

clue.text: Look out — dog in stable!

indicators.note: in places the dog word within the looking word

parts.note: to look out, or check, is to see (see that it's done)
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: A warning shout: watch out, there's a dog loose in the stable!
explanation.walkthrough: 'stable' looks like a noun for horses, but it is the adjective meaning firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Something secure is firmly fixed and steady, so stable is a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Carp caught by old member — Frank

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
M is short for member, as in MP
plain means frank, outspoken

explanation.surface: A fish landed by an old member of an angling club called Frank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carp' looks like the fish; it is the verb meaning to grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To carp is to find fault and grumble, which is what one does in complaining.

clue.text: Lack of resolution's first shown by the sailors in 19, perhaps

parts.note: no means none, a lack of something

indicators.note: first says take the opening letter of resolution

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy, Britain's sailors

explanation.surface: A navy crew in the Arctic shows a lack of resolve.
explanation.walkthrough: THE is taken as written. 19 is ARCTIC, an example of a northern region; Northern is also a London Underground line.
explanation.definitionFit: Arctic regions lie in the far north, so they are an example of something northern; the perhaps marks the example.

clue.text: Sailor-boy wearing waterproof

parts.note: a tar is a sailor
Paul is a boy's name
in means wearing, as in dressed in

explanation.surface: A sailor lad dressed in oilskins.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarpaulin is a heavy waterproof sheet; the word was also an old name for a sailor.

clue.text: Quarter of coppers cheated, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the answer sounds like the phrase given

parts.note: DIs are detective inspectors, police coppers, and cheated is tricked: DIs tricked

explanation.surface: A part of town where police officers were swindled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' could be coins; here they are police, the DIs. District is also a London Underground line.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarter of a city is a district, a distinct area or neighbourhood.

clue.text: I'm up, just, dressed in diving gear

indicators.note: to dress something is to arrange or prepare it, so these letters are set in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone has only just got up and pulled on a wetsuit for a dive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressed' looks like it is about putting on clothes, fitting the gear, but it signals the anagram of I'M UP JUST.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-piece suit covering body and limbs, of the kind worn by skydivers and divers.

clue.text: Great rejoicing when Jack meets topless sexy Oriental!

parts.note: J is short for jack in a pack of cards

indicators.note: topless says the first letter is removed

parts.note: nubile means sexually attractive
E is east, oriental

explanation.surface: A sailor, Jack, meets an attractive Eastern woman wearing no top, to great celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' looks racy but just removes the N of NUBILE.
explanation.definitionFit: A jubilee is a time of celebration and rejoicing, as for an anniversary; also a London Underground line.

clue.text: Chilling sound of Noah's clock?

indicators.note: sound of says the answer is heard as the phrase that follows

parts.note: Noah's vessel is the ark, and a clock goes tick, giving ark-tick

explanation.surface: A spooky question about the noise of a clock aboard Noah's boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Arctic is used figuratively for anything bitterly cold, freezing like the polar region.

clue.text: Principal clarinet I dismissed for discordance

indicators.note: discordance is disharmony, so the remaining letters are jumbled
dismissed says the letter I is sent out of the word

explanation.surface: A principal clarinettist sacked for playing out of tune.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing I from CLARINET leaves CLARNET, which is rearranged. Central is also a London Underground line.
explanation.definitionFit: Central means principal, the main or chief one, as in the central issue.

clue.text: Go with dream — put in wager on Oscar

indicators.note: put in says one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a bet is a wager
to long for something is to dream of it
O is Oscar in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Following a hunch, someone stakes money on an Oscar winner.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that go with each other are matched, as a lid belongs to a particular jar.

clue.text: Desert attractive Genevieve — partly as comeuppance?

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up means read upwards, so the letters are reversed
partly says the letters are part of the words that follow

explanation.surface: An attractive woman named Genevieve abandoned someone, and gets her just deserts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comeuppance' is split as come-up-pance, a pun on rising in the column.
explanation.definitionFit: The Negev is the desert region in southern Israel.

clue.text: Checked sharp edges of ashbin

parts.note: tart means sharp in taste

indicators.note: edges of takes the outermost letters of the word ashbin

explanation.surface: Someone sharply inspected the borders of a dustbin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Checked' looks like a verb for inspecting, but it is an adjective describing a pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: Tartan is the Scottish cloth woven in a pattern of crossing coloured bands, so it is a checked fabric.

clue.text: All the undermentioned tried tofu — incredibly — for starters

indicators.note: for starters means take the first letter of each word

explanation.surface: Everyone named below actually tried tofu, unbelievably.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutti is the musical direction for all performers to play together.

clue.text: Fancy wife with that bloke

parts.note: him refers to a man, that bloke

explanation.surface: Fancy the wife being with that man!
explanation.definitionFit: A whim is a sudden fancy, a passing notion or impulse.

clue.text: Couched in deceit

definitions.meaning: reclining, stretched out as on a couch

explanation.surface: A phrase like 'couched in deceit', words wrapped in dishonesty.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying means both reclining on something and telling falsehoods.

clue.text: Iran loath to use gas installation?

indicators.note: to use something is to work on it, so the letters of the two words are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Iran is reluctant to make use of a gas plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gas installation' suggests a pipeline or plant; here it is a device that installs a gas or vapour into your lungs.
explanation.definitionFit: A device for breathing in medicine as a vapour, cryptically something that puts a gas into the body.

clue.text: Very sick Italian dictator quietly accepted dietary supplement

parts.note: It is short for Italian, as in It vermouth
Idi Amin was the dictator of Uganda
p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly
ill means sick

explanation.surface: A gravely ill Italian dictator has quietly agreed to take a dietary supplement.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces are put in answer order: ILL comes last though 'sick' is near the start.
explanation.definitionFit: A tablet of vitamins is taken to supplement the diet.
